name: Stochastic Solid Gaussian Rendering
definition: A method that treats Gaussian primitives as stochastic solids to enable principled, multi-view-consistent shape reconstruction and depth rendering, overcoming the heuristic nature of prior Gaussian Splatting geometry extraction.
summary: Stochastic Solid Gaussian Rendering treats 3D Gaussians as stochastic solids to derive a continuous attenuation coefficient, enabling mathematically equivalent volume rendering and multi-view-consistent depth estimation.
